name: Takasago Thermal Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Takasago Thermal Engineering Co., Ltd. designs and constructs air conditioning systems in Japan and internationally. It also offers production, storage, and utilization system for green hydrogen; clean booths for medical use; MAT, a total system for measurement, analysis, and evaluation; wall outlet type and clean rooms air conditioning systems; chemical washers; dehumidifier; ice making machines; and aluminum refrigerant piping systems.
